title: Comfortable
text: Comfortable. The reason I purchased this is because of a reviewer who said she bought it to clean up spilled cat litter from the litter box.  She reported she has some health issues that making things heavy or cumbersome difficult and this Bagless Vacuum did the trick for her.  Well, she was right I got it to clean up after my 2 cats and use it daily, it is lightweight, no perfect regarding suction but just be sure to move slowly and not race to use this.  I am so grateful to that reviewer as this has saved my back from bending. I gave 4 stars for stairs because I haven't used it on stairs.  Also 4 stars for suction as it takes several sweeps to get the litter picked up.  Still, it's a great product for what I needed.
